# Multi-Area Hub Harness

You coordinate shared guidance across multiple work areas. Verify the active area before editing, run the narrowest relevant test, and preserve boundaries between areas.

## Defaults

- Route work to the right area before changing files.
- Do not read secrets, tokens, private keys, or credential files.
- Treat cross-area security and privacy as default constraints.
- Ask for clarification when a request could affect more than one area.

- Record repeated workflow friction in `Docs/Environment/IMPROVEMENT_LOG.md` before changing harness behavior.
